description:
Parse CSV text into JSON. Uses the first row as headers unless header=false.

Returns: JSON array of row objects keyed by the header row.
Example input: {"text":"name,age\nAda,36\nGrace,85","delimiter":","}
On error, includes hint: `text` must be CSV with a header row unless `header:false`. Escape embedded quotes as "".

header.description: First row is header (default true). If false, returns array of arrays.

name: csv_to_json
title: CSV to JSON
